question: Find the third proportional of 18 and 30.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The third proportional to any two numbers is found by dividing the square of the second number by the first number.

⇒ Third proportional = (30 × 30) ÷ 18

⇒ 900 ÷ 18 = 50

**∴ The correct answer is 50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number (a) = 18

Second number (b) = 30

**Formula Used:**

If three numbers a, b, and c are in continued proportion, their ratio maintains a constant multiplier:

⇒ a : b :: b : c ⇒ a ÷ b = b ÷ c

⇒ c = b² ÷ a
